origin: Andretti Global's story begins not in a corporate boardroom, but in a bustling suburban garage just outside Indianapolis. It was 2018 when cousins Marco and Olivia Andretti, fueled by a shared passion for racing and a modest inheritance from their grandfather, decided to turn their weekend tinkering into a serious amateur racing endeavor. They started with a single, well-worn Formula Ford, pouring their savings and countless hours into its restoration and modification. The initial races were a humbling experience, often ending in mechanical failures or mid-pack finishes. However, their determination and the raw talent of Olivia behind the wheel started to attract attention.
philosophy: Andretti Global operates on a philosophy of relentless improvement and driver development. They believe in providing young, talented drivers with the best possible equipment and mentorship to hone their skills. Their approach to car development is pragmatic and data-driven, focusing on maximizing the performance of readily available components rather than chasing expensive, cutting-edge technologies. The team culture is one of family and camaraderie, fostering a supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and learn from their mistakes.
achievements: 2020 SCCA National Championship Runoffs - Formula Ford - Olivia Andretti (Podium Finish)
2021 Indy Pro 2000 Championship - Multiple Top 5 Finishes
2022 USF2000 Championship - Olivia Andretti - Rookie of the Year
2023 USF2000 Championship - Team secured a manufacturer partnership with Mygale

teamPrincipal.name: Marco Andretti
teamPrincipal.background: Marco, while not the driver, is the strategic mind behind Andretti Global. He manages the team's operations, secures sponsorships, and oversees the driver development program with a keen eye for detail, ensuring the team punches above its weight.

keyFigures.name: Olivia Andretti
keyFigures.description: Olivia is the heart and soul of Andretti Global, a naturally gifted driver with an aggressive driving style and an unwavering commitment to winning. She is also instrumental in providing feedback on car setup and development.

keyFigures.name: David Chen
keyFigures.description: David is a seasoned mechanic with decades of experience in amateur racing. His ingenuity and resourcefulness are invaluable in keeping the team's cars running smoothly on a limited budget.

headquarters: The team operates out of a modest workshop located in a light industrial park on the outskirts of Indianapolis. The facilities are basic but functional, featuring a small garage, a rudimentary fabrication area, and a cramped office space.
fanBase: Andretti Global's fanbase is primarily composed of local racing enthusiasts and family members. They are known for their unwavering support and enthusiastic presence at races, often sporting homemade team apparel and cheering loudly from the grandstands. Their social media presence is growing steadily, attracting a wider audience interested in following the team's underdog journey.
